equivalentIntegrationDecision.reason: The focused harness directly calls the registry, ownership policy, and claim consumer and constructs an in-memory URL. It does not execute the native event subscription and cold-start drainage, IosNativeCallsBridge auth/readiness behavior, Expo Router replacement, mounted thread effect, or actual external URL adapters.
equivalentIntegrationDecision.requiredBeforeAcceptance: Run the authorized simulator path or a mounted local integration harness that exercises the actual producer-to-router-to-thread-consumer and external-entry chains without bypassing them.

phase1Ci.reason: Full CI is prohibited until all four current Level C lanes report P0=0 and P1=0.

findings.summary: The canonical shared contract identifies the frozen D2B duplicate registry but does not define a complete Android producer-to-thread-consumer reconciliation. Its plan omits app/chat/[threadId].tsx, the frozen D2B checkpoint does not change that file, the synchronized D2C thread consumes iOS claims only, and the shared module exposes no Android producer wrapper yet.
evidence: config/assurance/native-call-transition-provenance-v1.json:d2bReconciliation has no app/chat/[threadId].tsx entry
frozen D2B head 44741942 changes eight paths and not app/chat/[threadId].tsx
app/chat/[threadId].tsx consumes only consumeTrustedIosCallKitNativeEventClaim under Platform.OS === ios
_lib/nativeCallTransitionProvenance.mjs defines the Android source policy but exports no registerTrustedAndroidNativeActionStore producer

the frozen D2B Android-only registry uses a 15000ms JS TTL, D2C's canonical registry uses 30000ms, and the native store uses 45000ms; the reconciliation plan mentions none of these lifetime boundaries
the frozen D2B payload uses schemaVersion and createdAt while the shared registry requires positive nativeEventGeneration; the mapping is not specified
findings.impact: The promised canonical D2B reuse path is incomplete. A naive resume can remove the duplicate registry without creating a usable Android claim/consumer, or can retain competing lifetime and replay semantics. Either outcome can lose trusted Answer/Decline actions or reopen inconsistent authority behavior.
findings.requiredResolution: Before D2C freeze, extend the machine-readable plan to cover the Android producer wrapper, app/chat/[threadId].tsx consumption, exact payload-to-nativeEventGeneration mapping, platform-scoped clear, and a fail-closed TTL rule across the 45s native store and 30s shared claim. D2B must then implement and test that exact plan without a duplicate registry.

findings.summary: D2C removed the thread's startCall/openCall consumers to make copied route text inert but retained legitimate in-app producers, so authenticated foreground Voice/Video and compatibility entry actions now degrade to ordinary navigation.
evidence: app/chat/index.tsx retains startCall producers
app/profile/[userId].tsx retains a startCall producer
app/communication/[roomId].tsx retains an openCall=1 compatibility producer
app/chat/[threadId].tsx contains neither requestedCallMode/autoStartCallRef nor requestedOpenCall/autoOpenCallRef
scripts/proof-chilly-chat-end-to-end-call-initiation.mjs requires the producer strings while rejecting every thread consumer, so it passes without proving the transition
findings.impact: The security correction creates a product behavior regression inside the reviewed native-call provenance domain, violating the non-regression and foreground-authenticated-UI requirements.
findings.requiredResolution: Use a trusted memory-only foreground navigation intent or another bounded internal authority for legitimate UI producers, while preserving external URLs as navigation-only, and add a mounted end-to-end regression proving exactly one internal start/open operation.

findings.summary: The repository-wide sole-creator guard recognizes only the literal registerTrustedIosCallKitNativeEvent identifier followed by an opening parenthesis. Aliased imports and computed namespace calls are invisible.
evidence: scripts/guard-ios-native-call-policy.mjs and scripts/test-ios-native-call-route-provenance.mjs use /registerTrustedIosCallKitNativeEvent\s*\(/
the current literal producer scan finds one app/_layout.tsx callsite
an aliased import/call probe produced zero matches
a computed namespace member probe produced zero matches
the reported extra-creator mutant appends a bare literal call and therefore does not cover valid import-binding aliases
findings.impact: The claimed structural sole-producer boundary and its anti-vacuity proof are incomplete; future production code can obtain the creator through a different binding without failing the guard.
findings.requiredResolution: Use an AST/import-binding-aware scan or structurally unexport the creator from general production access, and add compilable alias, namespace, destructuring, and computed-member mutants.

findings.summary: The iOS native-intent sanitizer clears every fragment, while the application-link parser intentionally reads fragment parameters for auth and recovery. The focused D2C suite does not execute those adjacent initial/live auth routes.
findings.requiredResolution: Add executable synthetic auth/recovery fragment fixtures proving required values still reach the canonical auth handler while native-call claim fragments remain excluded from navigation and analytics.
